best_idea: Run one ordered server-side check chain per special request (known, alive, cooldown, global lockout, casting, target, range, cost), start cooldowns on launch, and send the one result code back to the sender only, with the client showing server results rather than predicting them.
decision_why: The ordered chain and server-only result reply fit our rule that the server decides every request. The donor trusts client movement flags and falls back to the host's player for unknown senders; both are fixed in the design (server motion only, refuse unknown senders), and the triggered-cast bypass stays internal. Specials are row 13 and the server check is the intake for it.
acceptance: A server test: a fighter whose server motion says moving sends a special with a cast time above zero, and the server returns Moving and starts no cast; a special sent during its own cooldown returns NotReady and leaves the cooldown unchanged; a special sent with the target out of range returns OutOfRange to the sender only.
